note: DRAFT — v0.2.1 / B-004 Warrior skill questlines. Discoverable: Power Strike and Rage start on a level-up; Earthbreaker and Flame Cleave start when the rare drop is picked up or inspected. Completing a line unlocks that skill at rank 1; further ranks train at Calden. Soul Guard is parked (see Pitch Book). `desc` is player-facing; `notes` is design-only. Rewards are on the last step. `trigger` is level:N or item:<id>. Gates are checked when Calden would finish the line.

rows.name: The Weight of a Swing
rows.desc: Calden wants to see a real blow, not just a practice swing.
rows.objective: Go to the practice post by the east gate in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: B-004. Starts at level 2. Short on purpose so the first skill is not gated for long.

rows.name: The Weight of a Swing
rows.desc: A handful of twigs will do for a first lesson.
rows.objective: Collect 4 Twig and bring them to Calden.

rows.name: The Weight of a Swing
rows.desc: Land three honest swings on the post, then Calden will teach the first real blow.
rows.objective: Land 3 basic attacks (F) on the practice post.
rows.notes: Only the basic F swing counts, not skills. Reward grants Power Strike at rank 1.

rows.name: Blood Up
rows.desc: Rage hits harder — and so do the things that hit you back. Talk to Calden.
rows.objective: Talk to Calden about the bargain of Rage.
rows.notes: B-004. Starts at level 3. Calden explains the deal.

rows.name: Blood Up
rows.desc: Walk out to where the pasture meets the dirt path.
rows.objective: Reach the east end of Sunny Pasture, near the dirt path.
rows.notes: Place check, around the Crow stretch / east portal.

rows.name: Blood Up
rows.desc: Wool-Shoulder will not back down. Stay in the fight, then return to Calden.
rows.objective: Defeat Wool-Shoulder in the east pasture and return to Calden.
rows.notes: Named Wool Sheep variant. The point is to stay in a fight that hits back, not to kite it from town.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: The cracked stone wants to be more than a rock. Calden will know.
rows.objective: Bring the Cracked Bank Stone to Calden (level 3 and 5 STR).
rows.notes: B-004. Starts on pickup/inspect of cracked_bank_stone. You can find it early; Calden waits for the gate.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: The lesson is in the banks themselves.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: Pebbles and grit from the cuts. Bring them back.
rows.objective: Collect 8 Pebble and 6 Earth Grit, then bring them to Calden.
rows.notes: Moles and sprites. Turn in consumes the mats. Unlock quest itself uses materials already in the sheet.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: Bank-Cracker waits in a hollow of the banks.
rows.objective: Defeat Bank-Cracker in the Dirt Banks and return to Calden.
rows.notes: Named Burrow Mole. Reward: Earthbreaker rank 1. Nature Essence ×12 does not skip rank 2 (r2 still costs on the ×1.6 curve from 40).

rows.name: Hot Edge
rows.desc: The scale is still warm. Calden will only take it when you are ready.
rows.objective: Bring the Smoldering Scale to Calden (level 6 and 10 STR).
rows.notes: B-004. Starts on pickup/inspect of smoldering_scale. Quest steps stay in the Dirt Banks (Spark Bug is a shared drop source, not a shrine visit).

rows.name: Hot Edge
rows.desc: Warm Grain from the beetles. Enough to kindle a lesson.
rows.objective: Collect 6 Warm Grain from Ember Beetles and bring them to Calden.

rows.name: Hot Edge
rows.desc: Cinderback leaves a Live Ember. Bring it to Calden.
rows.objective: Defeat Cinderback in the Dirt Banks and bring its Live Ember to Calden.
rows.notes: Named Ember Beetle, guaranteed Live Ember. Reward: Flame Cleave rank 1. Elemental Essence ×12 is a taste, not a skipped rank.
